author: spidey simp
description: A custom banking and economic simulation system developed for the Spidey Republic server, including credit scores, bank accounts, bank chartering, capital requirements, reserves, and other financial-system mechanics.
install_msg: SpideyEconomy is designed specifically for the Spidey Republic server and is not intended for general installation.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs and economy-related data, including credit scores, bank accounts, balances, ownership interests, and other banking information.
